response: The clustering has not changed — it still organizes papers by astronomical topic rather than by research methodology. I need four clusters defined purely by *how* the work is done: (1) Observational papers that analyze telescope or instrument data, (2) Theoretical papers using analytical derivations or first-principles calculations, (3) Simulation papers running numerical codes (N-body, hydrodynamics, MHD, etc.), and (4) Instrumental/Methods papers focused on pipelines, statistical techniques, or new instruments. A paper about neutron star equations of state belongs with other theoretical papers, not with observational stellar detections; a paper running cosmological simulations belongs with other simulation papers, not with observational galaxy surveys. Please discard the topic-based structure entirely and recluster on methodology.
